title: Lean Times
body:
This is a configurable mod that makes the following changes:
- Farmland with crops above occasionally turns to dirt. The crops are not destroyed when this happens, but they do stop growing.
- Sweet berries grow slower and occasionally fail to grow and disappear.
- Animals grow slower and their breeding cooldown gets longer after each child.
- Chicken lay less and less eggs over time, and eggs have a lower chance of spawning a chicken.
- Less animals spawn during worldgen. Less animals and less fishes spawn after worldgen.
- Fishing takes longer.
- Honey heals 1 hunger point.
- Glow berries have a 5% chance of giving the poison effect.
- Kelp and other vertically growing plants have higher initial age and have a chance of starting with age 25 (no growth at all until replaced).
